description: Unauthenticated, read-only access to currently published postings on a named Ashby job board.

tools.name: posting-api_list-job-postings
tools.description: Returns currently published postings. Consumers displaying a normal board listing must exclude jobs where isListed is false. Required: jobBoardName. Optional: includeCompensation (default: false).

params.name: includeCompensation
params.description: Include public compensation information when available.

novel_features.name: Visibility-safe structured job discovery
novel_features.description: Lists only publicly listed Ashby jobs and supports structured filtering across department, team, location, workplace type, employment type, publication date, currency, and compensation range.
